# iAgentSi.com

> A conceptual digital asset exploring agency as a mediation layer between intelligences.

The name expresses intelligence, agency and superintelligence through its linguistic, visual and motion identity. Core concepts include agentic mediation, delegation, accountability and coordination. The agentic path to superintelligence is a conceptual proposition, not an established outcome.

## Primary references

- [Conceptual landing](https://iagentsi.com/): Identity, six propositions, possible applications and acquisition scope.
- [The Agentic Mediation Thesis — v1.0](https://iagentsi.com/thesis/): Canonical publication, terminology, boundaries and suggested citation.
- [The Agentic Mediation Thesis — Markdown](https://iagentsi.com/thesis/thesis.md): Text mirror of the canonical publication.

## Scope

Held and developed by Sohadot. Not an operating product, validated scientific theory or established technical standard. The conventional expansion of ASI is artificial superintelligence.

Suggested citation: Sohadot. iAgentSi: The Agentic Mediation Thesis. Version 1.0, 24 November 2026. https://iagentsi.com/thesis/.
